notes.title: Heroes & Dice is now on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]The turn-based strategy game I’ve been working on for a long time, [b]Heroes & Dice[/b], is now live on [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]![/p][p]You can download and play the latest and most polished demo version of the game right now.[/p][p]The full version will launch in July — until then, I’d love to hear your thoughts![/p][p]Have fun![/p]

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello!
The Heroes & Dice demo is now available. You can download this version and try out Heroes & Dice.
Feel free to reach out to me on my Discord channel as well.

https://discord.gg/PYYasnKe38

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The Heroes & Dice demo will be playable on April 8 with completely revamped visuals and enhanced juicy effects. In this demo, 3 heroes will be available for selection, and 1 dungeon will be ready to play. The remaining heroes and dungeons will be accessible in the full version.

For any feedback or suggestions, feel free to join my Discord channel:
https://discord.gg/PYYasnKe38

notes.title: Sell Your Items!
notes.notes:
Thanks to your valuable feedback, I’ve added a new mechanic to the game: the ability to sell items you no longer need! This feature was highly requested, and I’m excited to finally implement it to enhance your gameplay experience.

I truly appreciate the feedback I’ve received so far, and I’m eager to hear more from you! Your suggestions help shape the game into something even better. Let me know what you think about the new update or any other ideas you’d like to see in the future!

Join my Discord
https://discord.gg/PYYasnKe38

Best regards,
Berkay

notes.title: Playtest Is Ready
notes.notes:
You have one dungeon to explore in this version. Your feedback is very important to me, so please feel free to share your thoughts or report any bugs you encounter during your playtime. Any ideas are also welcome.

Please note that not all heroes and skills are available in this version.

You can also join my Discord server:
https://discord.gg/PYYasnKe38

Best regards,
Berkay

notes.title: Playtest Is About To Release
notes.notes:
Hello!

I’m planning to release a playtest version of my game in about a week. I’d be thrilled if you could join and test the game along with its features. Feel free to ask me any questions about it!

You can also join my Discord server to stay updated more quickly.

Best regards,
Berkay
